name: Hot Buns Straight From The Coven!
source:
Lost in a forest, Berry is saved from probable death by a chance encounter with the beautiful witch Saffron, and it's love at first sight. But after spending two years as the witch's assistant, things are at a standstill and she's anxious for a change of pace. When Saffron's long estranged sister suddenly reappears, Berry might have her hands full with the feisty new witch!

[From [url=https://lapis-lazulily.itch.io/hot-buns-straight-from-the-coven]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
迷失在森林中的贝瑞偶然遇到了美丽的女巫萨弗伦，从可能的死亡中解救出来，两人一见钟情。但在担任女巫助手两年后，事情陷入了停滞，她渴望改变节奏。当藏红花疏远已久的妹妹突然再次出现时，贝瑞可能正忙着对付这位活跃的新女巫！

[来自[url=https://lapis-lazulily.itch.io/hot-buns-straight-from-the-coven]Itch.io[/url]]
